Resolves #21682

A timeline bar's `aria-label` now names its dates the way the header does: `TimeAxisHeader.formatWall` in the column's new reactive `locale_` config (default `Neo.config.locale`), in the axis zone. A bar from midnight to midnight names its days up to `lastWallMoment` (so a one-day bar reads `Survey the site (Nov 9)`), any other bar adds hours and minutes and reads up to `endDate` itself (`Nov 10, 08:00 – 13:00`), and a bar without length names one moment (`Inspection (Nov 16)`, `Handover (Nov 17, 14:00)`). The title stays first and the `barKey` fallback for an untitled bar is unchanged. Public behavior: only the accessible name of bars changes (Scheduler, Gantt and timeline examples); no migration.

Evidence: L2 (unit spec `test/playwright/unit/timeline/Column.spec.mjs`, run locally) -> L2 required (AC-6 names the unit spec).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `Column.spec.mjs` "a bar from midnight to midnight names the days it covers, not the exclusive end": `Survey the site (Nov 9)` and a two-day bar `Nov 12 – 13` (red on `dev`) |
| AC-2 | "a bar within a day names its date once and reads up to its end time": `Nov 10, 08:00 – 13:00`, asserts no `12:59` (red on `dev`) |
| AC-3 | "a bar without length names one date or one moment": `Inspection (Nov 16)`, `Handover (Nov 17, 14:00)` (red on `dev`) |
| AC-4 | "the dates follow the column locale": `Survey the site (9. Nov.)` with `locale: 'de-DE'` (red on `dev`) |
| AC-5 | "the dates are read in the axis zone": a midnight-to-midnight bar on a `Pacific/Auckland` axis reads `Nov 10`; the spec also passes with `TZ=America/Los_Angeles` and `TZ=Pacific/Auckland` |
| AC-6 | `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/timeline/Column.spec.mjs`: 13 passed |

## Deltas from ticket
- `afterSetLocale` re-renders mounted rows, as `TimeAxisHeader#afterSetLocale` re-projects, so changing `locale` at runtime updates the names.
- The label logic sits in a small `formatBarDates(startDate, endDate)` method instead of inline in `buildBarVdom`.

## Test Evidence
- `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/timeline/Column.spec.mjs`: 13 passed; with the source change reverted the 5 new tests fail and the 8 existing ones pass.
- The same spec with `TZ=America/Los_Angeles` and `TZ=Pacific/Auckland`: 13 passed each.
- `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/timeline test/playwright/unit/gantt test/playwright/unit/scheduler`: 130 passed.
- `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit-tz.mjs`: 32 passed.
- The lint-staged checks on both files (`check-whitespace`, `check-shorthand`, `check-jsdoc-types`, `check-block-alignment`, `check-parse`, `check-derived-domain`, `check-fixed-sleeps`, `check-engine-brain-boundary`, `neo-agent-skills-secrets`): clean.

## Post-Merge Validation
None required.
